authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3103 kāleyaka expressly discusses the heart/liver semantic overlap and gives Hindi karejā heart/liver, Assamese kɔlizā heart and Gujarati kāḷjũ heart/liver. The survey kalja/kaleja/kareja heart words fit this explicitly documented sense family. Exact survey form kalja is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7918 parṇa explicitly gives Hindi/Marwari pān and Gujarati pān/pā̃dṛũ leaf. These leaf responses, including the ṛ-extended series, select section 1; the competing pārṇa branch concerns betel leaves specifically. Exact survey form pan is preserved.
